subject: Experience M1 shell done; lockfile and root workspace note
body: @peak-state/app runs all five screens end to end on stubs. Typecheck, 9 Vitest tests and the build pass, and the build has no external URLs. Running npm install at the root creates a root package-lock.json that no lane owns, so I install with --no-package-lock and commit no lockfile. Please decide whether coord owns a root lockfile. Root 'npm test' and 'npm run typecheck' pick up app's scripts.
